name: medium-research-hn
description: Hacker News research with normalized MCP output. Documents the .mcpb user_config keychain pattern every credentialed server copies: each secret is a user_config field marked "sensitive": true (stored in the OS keychain, masked on input) and injected into mcp_config.env via ${user_config.<field>} at spawn — never written to disk in plaintext. HN itself needs no credentials; the fields below illustrate the pattern for later credentialed sources. KNOWN GOTCHA: ${user_config.*} env refs are solid in Claude Desktop but rough on the Claude Code plugin path (a bundled server can silently fail to spawn) — if it does not appear, check `claude mcp list`. Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.

reddit_client_secret.title: Reddit client secret
reddit_client_secret.description: Optional — enables the authenticated Reddit OAuth2 password grant (also needs a registered script app's client_id + username/password).
